# Abstract

Replace this paragraph with the research question, method, results and limits.

# Introduction

State the scientific question and the evidence that motivates it.
Disclose any model-assisted code, analysis or text preparation here.

# Methods

Describe the input sources, tool versions, analysis parameters and controls.
Record the model provider, product tier and relevant settings when a model contributes to the work.

# Results

Report measured results with tables or figures and their source records.

# Discussion

Explain what the evidence supports and which questions remain unresolved.

# Data and code availability

State how readers can obtain the code and any permitted supporting data.
